title: ElectionWatch Snapshot v1
description: Top-level snapshot published every 30 s to R2 live/snapshot.json; consumed by the frontend overview page.

version.description: Schema version — increment on breaking changes.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (with IST offset +05:30) of the last scraper write.

scraper_run_id.description: Scraper cycle identifier: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS for home scraper; watchdog_<ts> for CF Worker.

states.description: One entry per in-cycle state, ordered by ECI state code.

national.description: Aggregate national view across all 824 constituencies.

declared.description: Total constituencies where result has been declared across all states.

leading.description: Party code → seats where party is leading or has won nationally.

vote_share.description: Party code → vote percentage. Empty object if vote data unavailable.

data_source.description: Which scraper path produced this snapshot.

stale.description: True when scraper has not pushed a fresh cycle in >90 s; frontend shows stale banner.

banner.description: Optional user-facing banner message (set by watchdog on degraded writes).

total_ac.description: Total assembly constituencies in this state.

declared.description: Number of constituencies where result has been declared.

leading.description: Party code → seats where party is leading or has won in this state.
